title: Closure under identifying input variables
statement: For all natural numbers $n,m$, every map $\pi:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,\ldots,m\}$, and every linear threshold function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, the function $w\mapsto f(w_{\pi(1)},\ldots,w_{\pi(n)})$ is also a linear threshold function. Here a linear threshold function has the form $f(x)=1$ when $a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n a_ix_i\ge 0$ and $f(x)=-1$ otherwise, for some real coefficients $a_0,a_1,\ldots,a_n$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is an arbitrary map from the $n$ input coordinates to the $m$ input coordinates
$f$ is a linear threshold function on sign vectors of length $n$
